decisions.reason: As a new but closely related heat-exchange product, its market potential is still uncertain and the cost of keeping it listed for industrial customers is likely low, so the option value favors waiting.
Because it is one of two very similar condenser offers, it has some consolidation risk, but after only one year the firm would likely keep it to learn more before pruning.
This condenser has the highest near-term exit risk because its value may overlap with other offers, yet uncertainty is still high enough that management would probably keep the option open for now.
A liner for corroded heat exchanger tubes is tightly linked to the firm's installed-base service business and should be inexpensive to keep on the market, so dropping it soon is unlikely.
A customized industrial air cooler fits an engineer-to-order German machinery business well, giving it low carrying cost and good option value while demand becomes clearer.
Heat exchanger tube end repair inserts are a complementary maintenance product with strong adjacency to the core business, so the firm would usually retain them pending more evidence.
